# Inter and Inter Display

The Inter Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1, bundled beside this file.
Downloaded 2026-11-07 from the project's own site. The browser makes no runtime
font request.

- Upstream: https://github.com/rsms/inter (release v4.1)
- Font: https://rsms.me/inter/font-files/InterVariable.woff2
- Licence: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsms/inter/v4.1/LICENSE.txt
- Used by `--studio-font` and `--studio-display` in `gui/tokens.css`.

One variable file carries both cuts, with a weight axis (100–900) and an optical
size axis (14–32). Browsers follow the text's size on that axis, so 14 px text gets
Inter and 32 px and larger gets Inter Display.
